groups.targetNormals: Flat geometric triangle normals; no RGB component flips
groups.sourceFiltering: Evaluated world face AND every original corner geometric normal dot dominant26Direction >= cos(60deg)
groups.sourceFilterChoice: 60-degree cone retains sloped rolled-grass faces deleted by the former 45-degree cone; maximum 26-bin deviation 27.4 degrees gives an 87.4-degree geometric bound. Actual shader normals still require the unchanged strict baked-normal gate.
groups.sourceMaterialNormalPolicy: True high smooth geometric normals; temporary BSDF.Normal links disconnected, original source materials unchanged
